notes.name: Записки
notes.subject: A single sculptural warm ivory sheet of subtly textured paper folded into an elegant arch, on a matte taupe studio plinth. True paper fibers, soft long shadow.

chess.name: Шахматы
chess.purpose: Играть в шахматы и развивать стратегическое мышление
chess.subject: A single beautifully carved warm ivory chess knight on a dark charcoal and bone chess board. Rich ceramic surface, subtle tactile imperfections, glossy small highlights.
chess.alt: Светлый шахматный конь на графитовой доске

tavysh.name: Тавыш
tavysh.subject: A continuous translucent smoky champagne glass ribbon flowing left to right in two beautiful sinusoidal waves through a dark graphite studio. Slender warm ivory-gold waveform lines in the distance. Beautiful refraction and luminous edges.
tavysh.alt: Золотистая звуковая волна из прозрачного стекла

hive.name: HIVE
hive.subject: Five large translucent hexagonal glass slabs standing upright on dark brushed graphite, arranged as a connected honeycomb sculpture: clear smoked glass, deep forest-green glass and ivory frosted glass. Exact regular hexagons with exquisite thin bevels, elegant overlapping depth.

focus.name: Фокус
focus.subject: One freestanding perfectly circular lilac translucent glass ring standing on a soft dark plum studio surface. Slender ring with polished subtle luminous edge, delicate realistic refraction, blank interior and long quiet shadow.

pulse.name: Pulse
pulse.subject: Five softly rounded upright sage ivory glass columns in an ascending sequence from left to right, sculptural bar-chart still-life on a dark forest graphite studio surface. Precise rounded tops, frosted ceramic-glass material, soft highlights and realistic shadows.
pulse.alt: Пять растущих столбцов из светлого матового стекла
